name: test-setup
description: Tests run via `npm test` (jest-expo preset); pure-fn specs live in src/lib/__tests__/
body: The project uses jest with the jest-expo preset (configured in package.json "jest" key). Run `npm test`. Pure-function unit tests live alongside their module in src/lib/__tests__/*.test.js. money.js and balances.js are fully covered (20 tests). Note: jest writes PASS/FAIL to stderr, so PowerShell's NativeCommandError wrapper on the output is benign — read the summary line. parseAmount strips all non-[0-9.] chars, so negative strings become positive (locked by test). When adding a pure helper (e.g. src/lib/tasks.js), add a sibling __tests__ spec.
